findings.detail: `services/geminiService.ts:161-174` carries its own `GEMINI_KEY_STORAGE` constant and its own exported `getStoredApiKeys` / `setStoredApiKeys`, duplicating `services/apiKeyStorage.ts` verbatim. This PR is the evidence of the cost: the same three-line Groq deletion had to be made in both files. Neither geminiService export is imported anywhere — App.tsx imports both from `apiKeyStorage` (App.tsx:8), and the only in-file consumer is `getStoredApiKey` at geminiService.ts:176. So `setStoredApiKeys` is a wholly unused export and `getStoredApiKeys` is a redundant one. The concrete failure this sets up: the storage key literal `'gemini_api_key'` now exists in two files, and a future rename applied to only one makes the modal save under one key while the AI service reads another — every AI feature silently stops working with a valid key on screen. Acknowledged in the body of commit 8859037 as 'the dead duplicate storage API', but a commit message is not somewhere a future reader queries; it has no TD id and no register row.
findings.summary: Groq removal had to be applied twice — geminiService still duplicates the key-storage API

findings.detail: The committed skill runs `"$PYTHON" -m pip install graphifyy -q || "$PYTHON" -m pip install graphifyy -q --break-system-packages` (SKILL.md:92-93) when graphify is not importable and `uv` is absent. Two distinct problems. First, `--break-system-packages` writes to a distro-managed Python on the machine of a teammate whose only action was typing `/graphify` — ADR-0007 § Consequences and `docs/tooling/graphify.md` both warn about this, but a prose prerequisite does not gate an executing shell command, and the reason given for not patching it (the next `graphify install` overwrites the file) argues for a guard outside the vendored file, not for no guard. Second, and not covered anywhere in the PR: the install is **unpinned**, while `.claude/skills/graphify/.graphify_version` pins 0.8.44 and ADR-0007 reviews the local-only egress guarantees of that specific version. A bootstrapping teammate therefore gets whatever is latest on PyPI, which is not the version whose network behaviour was verified in ADR-0007 § Why.
findings.summary: Vendored skill bootstrap pip-installs an unpinned package, overriding pip's system-Python guard

findings.detail: `decodePayload` wraps `Buffer.from(padded, 'base64').toString('utf8')` in a try/catch that calls `die(REFUSALS.payload)`. Node's base64 decoder silently discards characters outside the alphabet rather than throwing, and `toString('utf8')` substitutes U+FFFD rather than throwing, so lines 91-93 can never execute. Behaviour is still correct — garbage falls through to the `JSON.parse` catch at line 98 and produces the same refusal — so there is no user-visible defect, only a dead branch that reads as a handled case. Worth noting because this script's whole value proposition is that it can be audited by reading it (lines 12-21 make that claim explicitly), and a reader tracing the failure paths will conclude one of them is live when it is not.
findings.summary: Unreachable catch — Buffer.from(str, 'base64') does not throw on malformed input

findings.detail: The Groq removal is complete in code, but the user-entered Groq key survives in `localStorage` for anyone who ever typed one, and this PR deletes the last UI that could clear it. That is documented — `docs/modules/open-decisions.md` § D5 and `docs/modules/MODULE_GUIDE.md:536` both state it plainly, and the maintainer explicitly reserved the fix. Under `handbooks/general/technical-debt.md` that makes it deliberate and owned, so it is not a violation. The narrow problem is *where* it is recorded: D5 opens with '**RESOLVED 2026-08-17 — implemented as recommended**', which is exactly the point a reader stops reading, and the register that this PR did edit (adding TD-049) has no row for it. TD-048 tracks the structurally identical `rewaa_admin_token` orphan and gets a row; this one does not. Two dev scripts also still seed the key (`scripts/measure-mobile-overflow.mjs:12`, `scripts/observe-origins.mjs:46`) — outside this diff, but they are the same loose end.
findings.summary: Orphaned localStorage['groq_api_key'] is recorded only under a heading marked RESOLVED
